segments.he: וְאִם אָמַר הִפְרַשְׁתִּי לְתוֹכָהּ רְבִיעִית קֹדֶשׁ — נֶאֱמָן. תְּנַן הָתָם: מוֹדִין בֵּית שַׁמַּאי וּבֵית הִלֵּל שֶׁבּוֹדְקִין לְעוֹשֵׂי פֶסַח, וְאֵין בּוֹדְקִין לְאוֹכְלֵי תְרוּמָה.
segments.en: § It was taught in the mishna: «And if» the giver «says» to the priest: «I separated» and placed «into» this barrel of teruma «a quarter»-log «of sacrificial» wine or oil, «he is deemed credible.» The Gemara proceeds to cite a mishna in tractate Oholot, the discussion of which ultimately relates to this mishna here: «We learned» in a mishna «elsewhere» (Oholot 18:4): «Beit Shammai and Beit Hillel agree that one may examine» the ground «for those performing the paschal» offering, «but one may not examine» the ground «for those who eat teruma.»
